parts.text: (c) A radiation detector used in a laboratory detects a background count rate of 30 counts / min. A radioactive source is placed in front of the radiation detector. The initial reading on the detector is 550 counts / min. The half-life of the source is 25 minutes. Calculate the expected reading on the detector after 75 minutes. reading = ...................................... counts / min [4]
